pressure.description: Upstream (red) the system pressure rises; downstream (blue) is the relief line at near-atmospheric pressure. At the burst pressure (within the stated tolerance at the coincident temperature) the scored dome tears along the score lines and the petals open fully.

summary: A rupture (bursting) disc is a non-reclosing pressure-relief device: a thin metal membrane designed to burst at a specified pressure and temperature, opening a full relief path in milliseconds. It is used alone where fast, leak-tight relief is needed, or upstream of a safety valve to isolate it from corrosive process fluid.

parts.name: Disc Holder (inlet & outlet rings) with Tag

rd_holder.function: Clamps and centres the disc between the pipe flanges.
rd_holder.construction: Inlet and outlet holder rings; tag shows burst pressure, temperature, lot.
rd_holder.operating_conditions: Install in the correct flow direction.

rd_disc.function: Bursts at the rated pressure to open a full relief path.
rd_disc.construction: Domed metal membrane with score lines forming petals.
rd_disc.operating_conditions: Operating ratio (operating/burst pressure) limits life; cycling and temperature matter.

pipework.function: Connects the pump to the system.
pipework.construction: Flanged pipe spools, fittings and supports; suction piping laid out to give uniform flow into the pump (straight run, eccentric reducers flat side up).
pipework.material: Carbon steel, stainless steel, ductile iron, HDPE/PVC as appropriate.
pipework.operating_conditions: Piping must be supported independently so nozzle loads stay within limits.
inspection: Check supports and flange alignment before bolting to pump

pressure_gauge.function: Indicates suction or discharge pressure for operation and performance checks.
pressure_gauge.construction: Bourdon-tube gauge with isolation valve; glycerine filled for pulsating service.
pressure_gauge.material: Stainless steel case and wetted parts.
pressure_gauge.operating_conditions: Range so that normal reading is mid-scale.
